# aikido_task_tracking_team_mapping (Resource)

Maps Aikido teams to task-tracker projects (Linear, Jira, and others). This is team mapping, not code-repository mapping. Define one resource per task-tracker integration. Omit integration_id when the workspace has a single integration. The Aikido API has no delete endpoint for this mapping, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the remote mapping unchanged.

This resource writes `POST /task_tracking/mapTeamsToProjects` and reads [Get project mapping](https://apidocs.aikido.dev/reference/getprojectmapping). Project IDs are those of the connected tracker (for Linear, the Linear team/project IDs). Values are Aikido team IDs.

-> This configures **team** mapping (`mapping_mode = teams`). Applying this resource switches the integration to team mapping.

-> Destroy does **not** unmap projects in Aikido. It only removes the resource from Terraform state.

Use a JSON file as the source of truth if you want to detect drift:

```terraform
resource "aikido_task_tracking_team_mapping" "linear" {
  integration_id    = 2
  project_teams_map = jsondecode(file("${path.module}/linear-team-map.json"))
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Maps Aikido teams to task-tracker projects (Linear, Jira, ...).
# This is team mapping, not code-repository mapping.
# Define one resource per task-tracker integration.
# Destroy only removes this resource from Terraform state; remote mappings stay as configured.
resource "aikido_task_tracking_team_mapping" "linear" {
  integration_id = 2

  project_teams_map = {
    "10000" = [1, 2, 3]
    "10001" = [4, 6]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_teams_map` (Map of Set of Number) Map of task-tracker project IDs to Aikido team IDs. Project IDs are those of the connected tracker (for example Linear team IDs or Jira project IDs). An empty team set unmaps that project. Projects omitted from the map are left unmapped in config; extra mapped projects in Aikido show as drift.

### Optional

- `integration_id` (Number) Task-tracker integration ID. Required when the workspace has more than one integration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Task tracking team-to-project mapping identifier. The integration ID when set, otherwise a workspace-wide sentinel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the workspace default mapping (no integration_id).
terraform import aikido_task_tracking_team_mapping.linear task_tracking_team_mapping

# Import a mapping for a specific task-tracker integration.
terraform import aikido_task_tracking_team_mapping.linear 2
```
